name: person
description: Someone, by name, with the colour they have everywhere in the workspace: who a record is for, who is here, who changed something.

use.when: a person is named beside what concerns them: who a task is for, who else is here.
use.not: a link to their page (use link), or a word that is not a person.
use.with: record and collection, where a record is for someone; presence.

colour.description: Their colour, 1 to 6, the same on every computer (chat.PersonColour of their login). Left out, the dot is neutral.

label.description: Words before the name, such as For, so the chip reads For Hana.

wcag.notes: The name is the meaning; the dot is aria-hidden decoration, so no one needs to tell colours apart. The name keeps the text colour at full contrast; the six colours are for marks, not text.

machine.identify: The text is the label and the name. data-person is their colour, 1 to 6.
